title: Naphtali's Inheritance
description: The sixth lot fell to the tribe of Naphtali. The boundary ran from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, past Adami-nekeb and Jabneel to the Jordan, then turned westward through Ashtaroth-karnaim and Hukkok toward Zebulun and Asher. They received nineteen fortified cities with their surrounding villages, including Kinnereth, Hazor, and Kedesh. [ref:Joshua 19:32-39|Joshua 19:32-39]
